messages:
Sam R: Hey all — short notice: flight delayed, need to swap primary coverage for tonight's 22:00-04:00 UTC block. I can still shadow later but can't take the first two hours. Anyone able to take primary 22:00-02:00 (or split)? :airplane:

Jia L: I can pick up 22:00-00:30 primary. prefer not to do full 4h if possible. :+1:

Morgan T: I can do 00:30-02:30 if that helps — covers overlap and gives Sam a clean shadow handback window.

Sam R: Awesome, thanks. Proposed: Jia primary 22:00-00:30, Morgan primary 00:30-02:30, Sam shadow 02:30-04:00. That leaves 02:30-02:30 overlap for handoff. Can we confirm? Also FYI embeds service has had some token-throttling retries today, so please watch `/metrics?service=embeds` and the embed queue. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/embeds-pager (see quick checks below).

Jia L: confirmed for 22:00-00:30. I'll ack any pagers during my window.

Morgan T: confirmed 00:30-02:30. If anything spikes before 00:30 I'll stay on until stable.

Sam R: quick runbook snippet — if you see 5xx ramp or high 429s, do this quick triage:

```
# check embed proxy pods
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=embed-proxy
# tail recent errors
kubectl -n prod logs deploy/embed-proxy -c proxy --since=15m | grep -i "429\|rate limit"
# check token cache hit rate from metrics service
curl -s "https://telemetry.internal/api/metrics?query=embed_token_cache_hit_rate"
```

Sam R: If you need to roll an immediate fallback model: change route in routing-config to `embed-model-v2-quant` and set `max_tokens=512` (that lowers latency). See section 3 in runbook.

Jia L: noted. Also leaving a quick pointer: if you need to escalate to infra, DM @matt-ops with subject `embeds-pager urgent` — he's online until 23:30 UTC.

incident-bot: Pager assignment: eng-oncall -> Jia L (primary) | Reason: embeds-429-surge | Pager links: https://pager.redwood/incidents/8471

Morgan T: seeing some minor retries in the staging stream; will watch prod once my slot starts. Can someone set a short-lived monitoring alert at 00:15 for a sanity check?

ops-bot: Quick note: rotation updated in rota-service: Jia L 22:00-00:30 (primary), Morgan T 00:30-02:30 (primary), Sam R shadow 02:30-04:00. :white_check_mark:

Sam R: thanks everyone. I'll leave a handoff note in the oncall doc at 02:25 with any outstanding items. If anything gets noisy, feel free to @Sam R / @Morgan T. :thumbsup:

Jia L: will do a concise handback at 00:25 with open alerts and current token error counts.

Morgan T: copied — will post full handback 02:25 with graph snapshots and any mitigations applied.

Sam R: Final ask — please include the short command I pasted in the incident ticket if you run it so we have reproducible steps. Cheers.

Jia L: 👍 adding that to the ticket now.

Morgan T: 👍

incident-bot: Reminder scheduled at 22:00 UTC: Primary handoff check-in (eng-oncall).
